title: GBAL end to end on the mock model ($0): the real init-root (test mode, fake clock) with init-root-fakekernel as the agent's kernel, a loopback deepseek mock upstream behind the Root's egress. Owner goal -> agent prediction -> self-change through the free-path Root admission (A0-A5) -> live tuple -> owner turns metered by the Root -> card reading (delta, sigma, se, z) -> outcome and calibration -> a second change that regresses the owner's guardrail is rolled back -> the agent stops with a recorded, Root-verified reason. Run by root/crates/init-root/tests/gbal.rs.
